patch.description:
Approve a pending POS signup request and create the POS account.

    This endpoint:
    - Validates that the request belongs to the authenticated Master POS.
    - Ensures the request status is "PendingApproval".
    - Creates the POS account.
    - Creates a wallet.
    - Generates a new signup token for the created POS.
    - Transfers documents to the POS account.
    - Updates signup request status to "Approved".
    - Sends account credentials email.

    Only Master POS accounts are allowed to perform this action.

The price is taken from your balance. clientRef is your own unique reference: sending the same clientRef again returns the original order instead of selling twice, so retry with it after a timeout.
